CAN = { if = { limit = { exists = yes }
if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = cw1970_personnel_initialized } }
	# Historical starting observations; no recurring manpower reset.
	# Unknown personnel/reserve fields are deliberately not initialized.
	set_country_flag = cw1970_personnel_initialized
	# Native law approximates the documented service system; no new mobilization mechanic.
	add_ideas = volunteer_army
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_active_total_k = 95 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_trained_reserve_k = 26.6 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_free_manpower_k = 26.6 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_owned_population_k = 21324 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_core_population_k = 21324 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_modeled_manpower_k = 16.177 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_unmodeled_active_k = 78.823 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_modeled_excess_k = 0 }
	set_country_flag = cw1970_personnel_source_available
	# This explicit total already includes any listed trained reserves.
	set_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 26.6 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = manpower_k }
	set_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_done = 0 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 4096
		value = cw1970_pool_iteration
		break = cw1970_pool_done
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k > 1000 } }
			add_manpower = 1000000
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 1000 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k < -1000 } }
			add_manpower = -1000000
			add_to_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 1000 }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_done = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cw1970_pool_done = 1 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 1000 }
		add_manpower = cw1970_pool_delta_k
	}
	else = { set_country_flag = cw1970_initial_pool_adjustment_incomplete }
}

} }

ENG = { if = { limit = { exists = yes }
if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = cw1970_personnel_initialized } }
	# Historical starting observations; no recurring manpower reset.
	# Unknown personnel/reserve fields are deliberately not initialized.
	set_country_flag = cw1970_personnel_initialized
	# Native law approximates the documented service system; no new mobilization mechanic.
	add_ideas = volunteer_army
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_active_total_k = 390 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_trained_reserve_k = 127.9 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_free_manpower_k = 127.9 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_owned_population_k = 61640.285 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_core_population_k = 59825.845 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_modeled_manpower_k = 20.87 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_unmodeled_active_k = 369.13 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_modeled_excess_k = 0 }
	set_country_flag = cw1970_personnel_source_available
	# This explicit total already includes any listed trained reserves.
	set_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 127.9 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = manpower_k }
	set_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_done = 0 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 4096
		value = cw1970_pool_iteration
		break = cw1970_pool_done
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k > 1000 } }
			add_manpower = 1000000
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 1000 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k < -1000 } }
			add_manpower = -1000000
			add_to_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 1000 }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_done = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cw1970_pool_done = 1 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 1000 }
		add_manpower = cw1970_pool_delta_k
	}
	else = { set_country_flag = cw1970_initial_pool_adjustment_incomplete }
}

} }

GER = { if = { limit = { exists = yes }
if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = cw1970_personnel_initialized } }
	# Historical starting observations; no recurring manpower reset.
	# Unknown personnel/reserve fields are deliberately not initialized.
	set_country_flag = cw1970_personnel_initialized
	# Native law approximates the documented service system; no new mobilization mechanic.
	add_ideas = draft_army
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_active_total_k = 510 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_trained_reserve_k = 750 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_free_manpower_k = 750 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_owned_population_k = 61001 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_core_population_k = 61001 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_modeled_manpower_k = 110.898 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_unmodeled_active_k = 399.102 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_modeled_excess_k = 0 }
	set_country_flag = cw1970_personnel_source_available
	# This explicit total already includes any listed trained reserves.
	set_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 750 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = manpower_k }
	set_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_done = 0 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 4096
		value = cw1970_pool_iteration
		break = cw1970_pool_done
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k > 1000 } }
			add_manpower = 1000000
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 1000 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k < -1000 } }
			add_manpower = -1000000
			add_to_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 1000 }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_done = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cw1970_pool_done = 1 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 1000 }
		add_manpower = cw1970_pool_delta_k
	}
	else = { set_country_flag = cw1970_initial_pool_adjustment_incomplete }
}

} }

NRY = { if = { limit = { exists = yes }
if = {
	limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = cw1970_personnel_initialized } }
	# Historical starting observations; no recurring manpower reset.
	# Unknown personnel/reserve fields are deliberately not initialized.
	set_country_flag = cw1970_personnel_initialized
	# Native law approximates the documented service system; no new mobilization mechanic.
	add_ideas = draft_army
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_active_total_k = 35 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_trained_reserve_k = 110 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_free_manpower_k = 110 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_owned_population_k = 3875.763 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_core_population_k = 3875.763 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_modeled_manpower_k = 3.15 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_unmodeled_active_k = 31.85 }
	set_variable = { cw1970_start_modeled_excess_k = 0 }
	set_country_flag = cw1970_personnel_source_available
	# This explicit total already includes any listed trained reserves.
	set_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 110 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = manpower_k }
	set_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_done = 0 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 4096
		value = cw1970_pool_iteration
		break = cw1970_pool_done
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k > 1000 } }
			add_manpower = 1000000
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 1000 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k < -1000 } }
			add_manpower = -1000000
			add_to_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 1000 }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_done = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cw1970_pool_done = 1 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cw1970_pool_delta_k = 1000 }
		add_manpower = cw1970_pool_delta_k
	}
	else = { set_country_flag = cw1970_initial_pool_adjustment_incomplete }
}

} }
